en: Black‑and‑white panoramic postcard view of a large Baroque monastery complex surrounded by trees and countryside. Multiple connected buildings with steep roofs and small towers form a quadrangle around an inner courtyard. A church tower with a spire rises near the center. In the foreground are orchards or gardens, while forested hills and an open landscape stretch into the background. At the top left, printed in red Gothic/antiqua script, is a German caption identifying the site.
